en: Well, well. A child, sticking their nose into Team Rocket's business. How brave. How stupid.
I'm Proton, the scariest man in Team Rocket. Cutting off a Slowpoke's tail is nothing to me. Shall I show you why?
Tch. Fine. We've made our money here anyway. Everyone out!
They've gone! Well done, youngster. My back may be no use, but you're worth ten of those crooks.
Come, let's get out of this damp hole. I'll see you at my house.
